newsitem.title: GREECE: Mytilineos in $517mln deal with Trepca.
newsitem.headline: Mytilineos in $517mln deal with Trepca.

text.p: Greek metals trader Mytilineos will sign a five-year contract worth $517 million with rump Yugoslavia for the modernisation and distribution of state mining group Trepca's products, it said.

The accord which calls for the development and modernisation of rump Yugoslavia's mines, will involve the processing of sulfur-based ores in Trepca's metallurgical unit and the distribution of final product in international markets by Mytilineos, it said.
"The Greek investment is insured by the Organisation for the Insurance of Export Credits (OAEP)," it added.
Mytilineos will sign the deal with state mining group Trepca, state export organisation Generalexport and state bank Jugobanka May 5.
Rump Yugoslavia's economy minister, central bank governor Bozidar Gazivoda and central bank deputy governor Ratco Banovic will be visiting Greece to attend the signing ceremony.

Yugoslavia's chamber of commerce chairman Mihajlo Milojevic, Serbia's coordination minister and vice-president Dragan Tomic and Kossovo's chamber of commerce chairman Obrad Jankovic will also be present at the signing, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
